label: Pipeline rig-related expenses deemed substantiated, per hour (no fuel provided)
index_cite: Rev. Proc. 2002-41 Q&A 14 as modified by Rev. Proc. 2006-53 §2.04 (§1(f)(3))

quotes: Rev. Proc. 2002-41, A-8 (2002-23 I.R.B. 1098): "If an eligible employer either provides fuel or separately reimburses fuel expenses, expenses of up to $8 per hour for welding rigs or mechanics rigs may be deemed substantiated ... If an eligible employer does not provide fuel or separately reimburse fuel expenses, rig-related expenses of up to $13 per hour for welding or mechanics rigs may be deemed substantiated"

Any adjustment to the rates provided in this revenue procedure will be published annually."

label: Eligible LTC premium limit, age 40 or less
special: НЕ §1(f)(3) COLA. Индекс — «medical care cost adjustment» за календарный год 2026 (налоговые годы, начинающиеся в 2026): числитель = медицинский компонент C-CPI-U за АВГУСТ 2025 (одно месячное значение, не среднее 12 месяцев); знаменатель = медицинский компонент CPI-U за АВГУСТ 1996 × [C-CPI-U(2016)/CPI-U(2016)] — множитель §1(f)(3)(B) берётся по ВСЕМ статьям и по средним за 12 месяцев до 31 августа 2016 (§1(f)(4), §1(f)(6)(B)). Округляется прирост до ближайших $10. Каждая из пяти сумм индексируется отдельно от своей базы.
quotes: §213(d)(10)(B)(i): "In the case of any taxable year beginning in a calendar year after 1997, each dollar amount contained in subparagraph (A) shall be increased by the medical care cost adjustment of such amount for such calendar year. If any increase determined under the preceding sentence is not a multiple of $10, such increase shall be rounded to the nearest multiple of $10."

§213(d)(10)(B)(ii): "the medical care cost adjustment for any calendar year is the percentage (if any) by which— (I) the medical care component of the C-CPI-U (as defined in section 1(f)(6)) for August of the preceding calendar year, exceeds (II) such component of the CPI (as defined in section 1(f)(4)) for August of 1996, multiplied by the amount determined under section 1(f)(3)(B). The Secretary shall, in consultation with the Secretary of Health and Human Services, prescribe an adjustment which the Secretary determines is more appropriate for purposes of this paragraph than the adjustment described in the preceding sentence, and the adjustment so prescribed shall apply in lieu of the adjustment described in the preceding sentence."
§1(f)(3)(B): "The amount determined under this clause is the amount obtained by dividing— (i) the C-CPI-U for calendar year 2016, by (ii) the CPI for calendar year 2016."

Amendment note, 2017 (P.L. 115-97 §11002(d)(7)), prior text: "(I) the medical care component of the Consumer Price Index (as defined in section 1(f)(5)) for August of the preceding calendar year, exceeds "(II) such component for August of 1996."
doubts: 1) Поручение называет индекс «медицинский компонент CPI, не C-CPI-U»; текст Кодекса после TCJA (P.L. 115-97 §11002(d)(7)) прямо говорит «medical care component of the C-CPI-U» в числителе; CPI-U (не цепной) остаётся только в базе августа 1996, умноженной на коэффициент сцепки §1(f)(3)(B). До 2018 года оба значения были по CPI-U. 2) Последнее предложение (ii) обязывает Secretary предписать «более подходящую» поправку, которая применяется вместо описанной; опубликована ли такая поправка — не установлено; Rev. Proc. метод не раскрывает. 3) Правило «latest values so published» §1(f)(6)(A) сформулировано для C-CPI-U; применимо ли оно к его медицинскому компоненту (значения C-CPI-U пересматриваются ~10–12 мес.) — текст прямо не говорит. 4) Правило разрыва при приросте, кратном $5, не задано. Данные медицинского компонента не искались (по поручению).

special: Значение 0.18 в самом Rev. Proc. отдельно не указано — оно из Announcement 2026-2. Округляется вся ставка вниз до цента. База 2022 > 2016 → COLA = C-CPI-U(2025)/C-CPI-U(2022) − 1 (§1(f)(3)(C)).
quotes: §4611(c)(2): "(A) the Hazardous Substance Superfund financing rate is 16.4 cents a barrel, and (B) the Oil Spill Liability Trust Fund financing rate is— (i) in the case of crude oil received or petroleum products entered before January 1, 2017, 8 cents a barrel, and (ii) in the case of crude oil received or petroleum products entered after December 31, 2016, 9 cents a barrel."

Proc. 2025-32 ... states that the inflation-adjusted amount for the § 4611 tax rate for the 2026 calendar year is $0.27 per barrel, which represents the sum of the $0.18 per barrel inflation-adjusted Superfund tax rate and the $0.09 per barrel OSLTF tax rate." §2: "The OSLTF tax rate expired on December 31, 2025.
